title: In 1966, Marlon Brando bought a private Polynesian atoll; it is now a wildlife sanctuary
summary_full: Marlon Brando's private atoll now serves as a crucial marine conservation site.  Thousands of green sea turtle hatchlings have been recorded after decades of protection efforts.  Habitat restoration and invasive species removal significantly aided this environmental transformation.  Eco-tourism at The Brando luxury resort helps fund ongoing scientific research and conservation initiatives.  While nesting beaches are safe, turtles face dangers from fishing and plastic pollution at sea.
